name: hyperliquid-trading-agent
description: Trade perpetual futures on Hyperliquid directly from Claude. Wraps the upstream sanketagarwal/hyperliquid-trading-agent repo as an MCP server + skills + commands. Dry-run by default; flip LIVE_TRADING=true to go live. Hard-coded risk guards (position size, leverage, exposure, daily drawdown, mandatory SL) run on every trade.
